interpretation_ko: 부단한 노력과 정성으로 높은 자리에 오를 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that you will rise to high places by your constant exertion and attention to your affairs

cite.original: To dream that you are possessed of riches, denotes that you will rise to high places by your constant exertion and attention to your affairs.
cite.translation_ko: 재물을 가진 꿈은, 부단한 노력과 정성으로 높은 자리에 오를 조짐이다

interpretation_en: the import of riddles is confusion and dissatisfaction

cite.original: The import of riddles is confusion and dissatisfaction.

interpretation_ko: 인내심을 시험하고 돈을 쓰게 할 사업에 뛰어들 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes you will engage in some enterprise which will try your patience and employ your money

cite.original: To dream that you are trying to solve riddles, denotes you will engage in some enterprise which will try your patience and employ your money.
cite.translation_ko: 수수께끼를 풀려고 하는 꿈은, 인내심을 시험하고 돈을 쓰게 할 사업에 뛰어들 조짐이다
